verdict.rationale: The portal documents acting "em representação" (on behalf of another), at least for subscribing to electronic notifications and citations, and has a dedicated services area for Contabilistas Certificados (certified accountants). Together these point to a sanctioned third-party rail through which an authorized provider can act for a company. Both are single-line homepage mentions with no detail on how a representative is authorized, its scope, or how a company grants or revokes access. Missing for 10: documented process for designating or authorizing a representative or accountant, scope of the delegated actions, revocation and audit controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
